# Digital Thriv: company and service facts

Canonical entity: https://www.digitalthriv.com/#organization
Official website: https://www.digitalthriv.com
Business location: Banda, Uttar Pradesh 208025, India
Languages: English and Hindi
Audience: dropshippers, ecommerce store owners, D2C founders, Shopify and WooCommerce website buyers, and ecommerce app buyers.

## What Digital Thriv does
Digital Thriv builds and improves ecommerce selling systems. Its public offers cover Shopify development, WooCommerce development, Android ecommerce app development, payment gateway integration, logistics integration, Meta advertising integration, catalog setup, conversion optimization and ecommerce performance marketing.

## Public starting packages

### Shopify dropshipping store — INR 2,999
Best for product testers and beginners. This is premium-theme, template-based work rather than a fully custom design. The published scope includes full website setup, catalog upload within an agreed limit, payment integration, logistics integration, Meta setup, and compatible dropshipping supplier integration.
Canonical page: https://www.digitalthriv.com/shopify-website-development-packages-india#dropshipping

### Customized D2C ecommerce store — INR 4,999
Best for D2C founders and ecommerce brands. The published scope adds higher customization, premium graphics and conversion-focused sections, alongside catalog and core integrations.
Canonical page: https://www.digitalthriv.com/shopify-website-development-packages-india#d2c

### WooCommerce D2C store — INR 4,999
Best for businesses that prefer WordPress and WooCommerce. The published scope includes website setup, catalog upload within an agreed limit, payment integration, logistics integration and Meta setup.
Canonical page: https://www.digitalthriv.com/woocommerce-development-d2c-india

### Ecommerce website and Android app — INR 9,999
Best for mobile-first D2C brands. The published scope includes a connected ecommerce website and Android shopping app, catalog setup, premium graphics, conversion-focused sections and core integrations.
Canonical page: https://www.digitalthriv.com/ecommerce-app-development-agency

### Existing store growth — custom scope
For ecommerce businesses that already have a store and need conversion optimization, tracking or acquisition support.
Canonical page: https://www.digitalthriv.com/ecommerce-growth-conversion-optimization

## Ownership, security and support
- Exact deliverables, limits, exclusions and relevant third-party charges are confirmed in a written quotation.
- The client controls the store account and business data.
- Access is used for the agreed implementation and support work.
- Included post-launch support is defined in the quotation. Continuing maintenance or growth work can be scoped separately.

## Reported operating figures
Digital Thriv reports more than 2,000 ecommerce stores built, more than INR 10 crore in ad spend managed, more than INR 200 crore in client revenue supported, and more than 11 years of ecommerce experience. These are cumulative company-reported operating figures, not guarantees of individual outcomes. Client results vary by product, market, offer and investment.
